subject: AtlasAI channel structure and leadflow discussion
messages:
From: Simon Gray <simon.gray@atlasai.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: AtlasAI x Redwood — initial channel ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the time at the summit — we left excited about how AtlasAI's analytics connector and Redwood's inference platform could create a straight path for our joint customers. Attaching our standard Master SOW for context (AtlasAI_Master_SoW.pdf).

Top-of-mind commercial model from our side:
- Reseller option (AtlasAI sells a bundled subscription, Redwood receives a revenue share) — proposed split 70/30 (AtlasAI/Redwood) for a managed integration.
- Referral option (AtlasAI refers leads, Redwood owns billing) — 20% of first-year ARR as a referral fee.
- Lead registration: we typically ask for 180-day deal protection on registered leads.

We'd love to move to a short call to align on: definitions (what counts as a registered lead), marketplace listing expectations, and any onboarding credits/obligations. Are you available early next week?

Best,
Simon Gray
Head of Partnerships, AtlasAI
Simon.Gray@atlasai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Simon Gray <simon.gray@atlasai.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlasai.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AtlasAI x Redwood — initial channel ask

Hi Simon / Priya — great to hear and thanks for the SOW. Really like the mutual customer examples you sent.

We'd like to separate two paths so expectations are clear: a) reseller (AtlasAI resells bundled, handles billing) and b) referral (AtlasAI passes qualified leads, Redwood invoices). That affects revenue split and operational controls. A few starter questions from our side:
- Can you share how you define a "qualified, registered lead" today? (fields, lead source, who owns the demo)
- For reseller deals, is AtlasAI proposing to manage support + onboarding entirely, or will Redwood provide first-line support for inference issues?
- Are you flexible on the reseller split? 70/30 is wide — we usually see managed reseller splits in the 60/40 to 65/35 range when there is co-managed onboarding.
- Lead protection window: is 180 days firm? We typically do 90 days for inbound marketplace-sourced leads but can consider 180 for co-sourced enterprise introductions.

I'd like to schedule a 30-minute call with Camila (partner ops) and Ben (commercials) this week to map the leadflow and agree on workstreams. Proposed times: Wed 11/25 9:30am PT or Thu 11/26 11:00am PT. Which works?

I'll attach a short referral term sheet for discussion after we align on definitions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: AtlasAI commercial options & asks (internal)

Ben / Camila — pulling notes before the sync with Atlas. Simon's initial asks: reseller 70/30, referral 20% first year, 180-day lead protection. My read: their connector is strategic for data-platform customers, but we need clear ops rules.

Proposed options to present (concise):
1) Reseller — co-managed for enterprise only:
   - Split: 65/35 (AtlasAI/Redwood) for deals where Atlas handles GTM and onboarding; exception: self-serve marketplace installs are not resell-eligible.
   - Redwood provides inference SLAs; Atlas provides first-line customer success for onboarding.
   - Lead registration: 90-day protection for inbound marketplace leads; 180-day for co-sourced enterprise introductions, with written registration in the portal.
2) Referral — lightweight track:
   - Fee: 15% of first-year ARR (paid within 45 days of invoicing).
   - Qualification criteria: MQL -> SQL conversion, proof of budget or PO, and acceptance by Redwood AE.
3) Deal registration / conflict resolution:
   - Use HubSpot deal record (HUBSPOT-4352) as single source of truth. Registration via partner portal (manual email accepted for pilot).

Operational asks from partner ops: onboarding credits (one-time $5k credit for co-sold enterprise deals) and a clear escalation path for joint support. Legal will want a short term sheet covering IP indemnities and data handling.

Questions for Ben: can you confirm acceptable split floors (we probably won't go below 60/40 on reseller) and any lift from sales engineering for enterprise pilots?

Thanks — plan to present these as alternatives on the call and converge.

Marissa

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AtlasAI commercial options & asks (internal)

Quick thoughts — good framing. My commercial guardrails:
- Reseller split: I'm comfortable with 65/35 for managed enterprise where Atlas owns onboarding. For fully managed/resell where we do minimal SE lift, we should target 60/40. So floor = 60/40.
- Referral: 15% first-year ARR aligns with similar partners. Payment terms: net 45 after Redwood invoices is fine.
- Lead protection: 90 days standard; extend to 180 only for co-sourced exec introductions with registration proof.

Operationally: recommend we add a one-time onboarding credit for co-sold deals (Camila to confirm threshold). Also log every registration in HubSpot (HUBSPOT-4352) and set an internal SLA for registration disputes (48 hours to respond).

If we're aligned, I can draft the commercial bullets and push to legal to convert into a short partner addendum.

Ben
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Simon Gray <simon.gray@atlasai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlasai.com>
Cc: partnership@atlasai.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AtlasAI x Redwood — channel alignment follow-up

Marissa / team — thanks for the thoughtful options. We've reviewed internally. Agreed items:
- Referral track: Atlas accepts 15% of first-year ARR, paid net 45.
- Lead registration: 90 days for marketplace-sourced leads; 180 days for co-sourced enterprise intros with documented registration.
- Onboarding credits: we accept a one-time $5k credit for co-sold enterprise pilots.

Points to reconcile:
- Reseller split: Atlas cannot do 60/40 for the managed bundle; we'll accept 65/35 for managed resell only (not self-serve).

Next steps: please send a short partner term sheet reflecting the agreed referral %, the reseller carve (65/35 managed only), lead registration rules, and the onboarding credit. We'll sign via DocuSign and route for SOC review. Attaching our legal's suggested redlines as a starting point (see AtlasAI_Master_SoW.pdf previously).

Happy to get this into DocuSign today if you send the link.

Cheers,
Simon
Head of Partnerships, AtlasAI
